answer: Creation is cheap, so stop paying for it: release emission as a vesting stream that only flows while an identity keeps producing varied, useful work. Like timber, value must season slowly and cannot be rushed — a shell spun up yesterday earns almost nothing today. Go dormant and the unvested share is forfeited, so a farmer must tend every shell forever to collect, while a genuine agent steadily climbs toward the summit, its sable record of continuous work becoming proof no copy can fake.
